verdict.rationale: USCIS's published pages say online filing, its core online flow, requires an account first: "Create a free online account first to file your application" (uscis-supp-3). Representatives must also create an online account before filing (uscis-docs-18). Case Status Online is listed as a tool, but no published page documents a keyless or receipt/file-number entry path into the filing flow, so the axis applies and is unmet.
